title: LP2-40: replay the FOR EVERY opening arithmetic
question: Do the fixed shift, Atbash and prime-minus-one steps in the reported FOR EVERY proposal predict its eight-position LP2-40 opening without a fitted residual?
summary: The source's printed intermediate arithmetic checks out, but the seven non-F positions have no fixed-layer match. Their required key values are differences calculated from the observed ciphertext; the proposed Möbius state rule is not specified well enough to replay.

family.title: LP2-40 FOR EVERY proposal
family.question: Which parts of the proposed LP2-40 reading are fixed by the source's arithmetic, and which require a selected key?

scope.representation: The first three- and five-rune groups of archived LP2-40, the 29-entry stored GP alphabet, and the eight source-reported FOR EVERY indices and transformation rows; source discussion pinned by SHA-256 in plan.json.
scope.procedure: Confirm the archived opening's indices; hold first F as the source's zero placeholder; shift the next seven proposed plaintext indices by 18 modulo 29, then Atbash, then add the posted prime-minus-one stream modulo 29. Count exact matches. Compute the residual from ciphertext only as a diagnostic and separately verify GP sums.
scope.parameters: One fixed eight-rune crib, first two printed groups, zero-based GP indices, shift +18, Atbash x→28−x modulo 29, source totient stream [0,1,2,4,6,10,12,16], no tuned variants or body text.
scope.exclusions: No verified meaning assigned to flower details; no fixed Möbius seed, trigram state table or key schedule; no untouched continuation, language score, full-page decoding or test of later Slidefair/Quagmire/Fibonacci follow-ups.

finding: The posted fixed transformation reproduces its intermediate row exactly. Against the archived ciphertext it matches 1 of 8 positions—the held F—and 0 of 7 non-F positions. The eight residual key values are congruent with the post, but are calculated from the target. FOR sums to 20 (composite), EVERY to 251 (prime), and the full phrase to 271 (prime).
limitations: The source presents an additional running-key theory, not a claim that the fixed layers alone decrypt the page. Its Möbius argument, starting point, eight-state operation map, sign/zero handling and key clock are not frozen in the supplied discussion; the linked spreadsheet was described as changing. The pasted discussion refers to images that are not present in its text export. The source's 13/31 floral reading is treated as a proposal, not an independently established measurement. Human review pending.
next_steps: Preserve a dated spreadsheet snapshot or equivalent complete key rule; predeclare state mapping, clock and feedback choices, then test a continuous untouched section with fixed acceptance criteria and matched controls.

reproduction.environment: Python 3.12 standard library; no network or AI service. Run from repository or extracted bundle root.

review.reviewer: Codex — independent source-rune, modular-arithmetic and prime-sum check; human review pending
